//: Pinned public Python repos for the parser and resolution evaluation (dev set). Bump a sha deliberately and review the diff in results.
//selection: Chosen on 2026-11-05, before Drift was run on any of them, and fixed from then on (a separate held-out Python set exists and is not used here).

Shapes needed: a small canonical FastAPI app, a large production FastAPI server, Django + DRF, Django + Celery, a Flask app with blueprints and extensions, libraries (src layout, heavy __init__ re-exports), a monorepo of several pyproject packages.
Per shape, the best-known public repo that is actively maintained (default branch pushed within the last weeks); SHAs are the default-branch HEAD from git ls-remote on 2026-11-05.
This is a development set: findings on it drove fixes (router subclasses from polar, per-method view handlers from CTFd), so its numbers are not a held-out measurement.

repos.name: full-stack-fastapi-template
repos.shape: FastAPI app (SQLModel, Annotated dependencies) + React frontend

repos.name: polar
repos.shape: Large FastAPI + Dramatiq server in a TS monorepo
repos.//max_parse_errors: sdk/generator/python/template/**: Jinja templates with a .py extension, not Python

repos.name: saleor

repos.name: CTFd
repos.shape: Flask app: blueprints, flask-restx namespaces, app factory

repos.name: flask

repos.name: langchain
